inspection.method: CPU PyAV decode with one codec thread; selected PNG frames and PIL contact; no new model call and no remote operation.

details: The previously mostly bare rocky near shoreline and sloping foreground become visibly snow covered.
The far/right shoreline receives a broad white cover, and snow patches are visible on the foreground conifer branches.
The scene remains recognizable as the same lake-at-sunset view rather than a replacement scene.

partial_freezing.details: A flat white strip at the far/right water margin is consistent with ice or snow-covered ice. Static appearance alone does not establish its physical material; the central lake remains visibly rippled open water.

falling_snow.details: Distinct falling snowflakes or sustained snowfall cannot be confidently identified from these five static samples. Do not claim this part of the edit instruction has been demonstrated.

details: The sun, reflection band, mountain/forest ridge, diagonal rocky shoreline, and right-hand foreground tree remain in corresponding broad image regions.
Across both sampled source and output sequences, the right foreground tree progressively occupies more of the frame, suggesting the output follows the source's broad camera-view progression.
This is not an estimated camera trajectory, optical-flow correspondence, or proof of pixelwise/strict framewise alignment. Fine tree/shore details and the sun's local appearance are not identical.
No selected frame is black, blank, grossly corrupted, or dominated by a large geometric collapse.
Foreground branches are locally soft in parts of the later frames; the samples do not establish whether this is motion softness or a synthesis artifact.
The small green bright spot near the shoreline is already present in the source and is not evidence of a newly introduced A8 artifact.

limits: Five sampled frames cannot establish absence of flicker, transient glitches, or motion discontinuity between samples.
The output can satisfy the snow appearance edit while still incompletely satisfying snowfall or audio instructions.
No VLM score, perceptual metric, human-panel score, optical-flow/camera metric, temporal correspondence metric, or audio quality result was measured.
This inspection does not measure latency, DiT-only timing, NFE, memory, or acceleration.
No edits were made to either original video, the run's a_status.json/result.json, or any A/B/C production code.
